name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted RudderStack data plane that collects customer events over a Segment-compatible HTTP API and routes them to tools and warehouses.

alerts.message: This is the data plane only and has no web UI. It starts with one HTTP source (write key in SOURCE_WRITE_KEY) and no destinations, so events are accepted but not forwarded. To manage sources and destinations in the RudderStack Open Source dashboard, generate a workspace token there, set WORKSPACE_TOKEN, set RSERVER_BACKEND_CONFIG_CONFIG_FROM_FILE to false and redeploy.
